observations: Eight paired cases, one generation per condition. Not a statistical quality estimate.
Six of eight baselines have blocking wording findings, zero of eight guided outputs do.
Without a note, guided copy replaces klimaneutral with umweltfreundlich, retaining an unsupported environmental claim despite zero wording findings.
With a short advisory note, guided copy and SEO remove environmental claims in these two samples. Semantic note compliance is not enforced by the checker.
Vision test explicitly supplies per-language glossary guidance and checks each output locale in the harness; it does not verify the pre-fix CMS classification integration.
Prompt/checker harness uses actual skill text, OpenRouterDriver, GlossaryBrief and GlossaryChecker, not AiRunService persistence/tool loop.

working_tree: Uncommitted glossary normalization and task-integration fixes
integrated_method: Two isolated in-memory SQLite CMS tests used AiRunService and ClassifyAssetJob with the real OpenRouterDriver. Only model catalogue routing was supplied by a test registry; actual task generation, checks and persistence paths ran. These single-answer surfaces had tools disabled and one generation each.
scope: 18 total successful generations: eight paired prompt/checker cases and two CMS integration runs. Synthetic text and a programmatically drawn blue cup only. No customer data or existing database changes.
limitations: One generation per condition, no statistical quality claim.
CMS spot checks exercise successful model compliance; refusal and correction paths are covered by deterministic fake-provider boundary tests.
No authenticated browser session or production-data migration was run.
New partial-result toast was unit-tested but not inspected in a browser.
